action_space: select one of up to K verified protected candidates; action K is forced reject iff none capacity feasible
action_mask: audit-based safe mask; infeasible actions may not be selected
observation: 26 predeclared candidate-specific engineered attributes; partial observation of full scenario ledgers
reward: admitted service priority_weight / 5; otherwise 0; undiscounted evaluation uses priority-weighted admission
checkpoint_selection: validation mean priority-weighted admission, then unweighted admission; never test data
phase4_explored_seeds: 2027..2041; forbidden in final held-out Phase 5 evaluation
hypothesis: A DDQN policy that observes the current request and partial reservation-state features may improve future protected admission by choosing better among safe current candidates.
null: DDQN does not improve admission relative to greedy / CSPF-style / MILP V2 on held-out synthetic streams.
important_limitations: No RFC 8227 shared-ring protection signaling or timing
No node failures or simultaneous faults
Fixed topology seed for the primary evaluation
No service releases, preemption, or global route rearrangement
Only two policy-valid candidates observed in the Phase 3 primary workload
Candidate features do not encode complete state: fully Markov observation is NOT claimed
No real railway operational data, safety assurance, or protocol-compliance claim
Do not claim statistical equivalence from zero paired differences
